# NEW 2026-11-23 v16.0 Module 16.0-D: Byzantine Diocese Katepanate Voluntary Consolidation (oe_kat_, Scheme 3A Phase 2, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v160_katepanate.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Voluntary One-Click Diocese Katepanate Consolidation Edict (管区大督军区自愿整合敕令)
# Player-voluntary (ai_tick = never). Strictly preserves Naval Themes, Hereditary Themes, and Revolt-locked Themes.
oe_kat_consolidate_diocese_action = {
	type = internationalorganization
	show_message = no
	automation_tick = never
	automation_tick_frequency = 12
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			tag = BYZ
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
		exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			tag = BYZ
			at_war = no
			has_raised_levies = no
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_kat_req_diocese_or_scale_tt
				oe_kat_byz_ready = yes
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_kat_req_consolidatable_cluster_tt
				any_subject = { oe_kat_selectable_lead_theme = yes }
			}
		}
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_kat_auth_10_tt
				var:oe_pillars_authority >= 10
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_kat_consolidate_diocese_cd
		months = 12
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			scope:actor = { tag = BYZ }
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_empire_pillars
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		only_color_selectable = yes
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_country
		name = "oe_kat_choose_lead_theme"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_kat_no_lead_theme"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = great_power_score }
		visible = {
			root = { oe_kat_selectable_lead_theme = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target_country
				scope:actor = { tag = BYZ }
				scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
				scope:target_country = { oe_kat_selectable_lead_theme = yes }
				international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 10 }
			}
			oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -10 }
			custom_tooltip = oe_kat_consolidate_diocese_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:actor = { oe_kat_do_consolidate_diocese = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Reversible Diocese Katepanate Dissolution Edict (大督军区析还古典军区敕令)
# Full Scheme 3A reversibility: restores absorbed historical regions cleanly back to standalone Themes.
oe_kat_dissolve_katepanate_action = {
	type = internationalorganization
	show_message = no
	automation_tick = never
	automation_tick_frequency = 12
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			tag = BYZ
			is_rebel_country = no
			any_subject = { oe_kat_is_active_katepanate = yes }
		}
		exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			tag = BYZ
			at_war = no
			has_raised_levies = no
			any_subject = { oe_kat_is_active_katepanate = yes }
		}
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_kat_auth_5_tt
				var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5
			}
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_kat_dissolve_katepanate_cd
		months = 6
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			scope:actor = { tag = BYZ }
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_empire_pillars
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		only_color_selectable = yes
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_country
		name = "oe_kat_choose_dissolve_katepanate"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_kat_no_dissolve_katepanate"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = great_power_score }
		visible = {
			root = { oe_kat_is_active_katepanate = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target_country
				scope:actor = { tag = BYZ }
				scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
				scope:target_country = { oe_kat_is_active_katepanate = yes }
				international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
			}
			oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -5 }
			custom_tooltip = oe_kat_dissolve_katepanate_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:actor = { oe_kat_do_dissolve_katepanate = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}
